head_coach.name: Hong Myung-bo
head_coach.play_style_summary: A defense-first, highly structured approach that relies on a flexible three-back system to sit in a compact mid-to-low block while enabling swift, fluid transitions to attack using the squad's elite individual skill up front.

key_players.name: Lee Kang-in
key_players.performance_stats: The most valuable player in the squad, rotating between starting and key roles for Paris Saint-Germain; serves as South Korea's main creative hub and primary set-piece taker.

key_players.name: Kim Min-jae
key_players.performance_stats: Defensive linchpin for Bayern Munich; acts as the absolute leader and guaranteed starter in South Korea's back-three defensive setup.

key_players.name: Son Heung-min
key_players.performance_stats: National team captain currently playing for LAFC in MLS, where he recorded a dominant 12 goals and 4 assists in 13 matches during his debut campaign.
